title: 第58章 《新时代最可爱的人》

“指导员，我除了给爹娘说点话，我还跟我大伯说点话。我想告诉俺大伯，他之前参加了援越，狗崽子吃撑了反咬一口，我这次让他们把吃进肚子里的东西，全都吐出来。”
.......
高团长和赵政委分别赶赴各个连队巡查，又带来了一些慰问品。
“你们连有什么问题吗？”高团长望向刘济民和马贵生两人。
“报告团长，没有问题。”马贵生说道。
“你呢！”
“没有问题！”
“来的时候，王科长问你军报邀你写的文章，写好了吗？”
“写了两篇。”
“一会儿我带回去，你们在这个地方，东西带出去不容易。你们训练抓点紧，思想工作不能落下。我看你们九连的斗志很高，畏难情绪已经没有了。这很好，但是还要做到更好。以前在越南参战的顾问和高炮部队，送来了不少资料，你们抓紧研究。”
“是！”
高团长临走前来到了刘济民的房间，刘济民从桌子上拿出十几张稿纸递给了高团长。
刘济民总共给军报写了两篇稿子，第一篇叫做《年轻战士的心声：请祖国和人民放心》。
这篇文章通过对战士的深入访谈，展现了基层连队的真实想法，以及战士们对敌人残害边境同胞的痛恨和杀敌报国的决心。
第二篇叫做《新时代最可爱的人》，讲述了出国前最后一个春节，战士们如何在艰苦环境中依然保持乐观的战斗精神，过好最后一个春节。
高团长看到《新时代最可爱的人》最后的一段话，沉默了许久。
【祖国啊，这是我出征前最后的一个春节，让我再看你一眼吧！
妈妈，这是我第一次出国，也许我会倒下，再也不会回来！
妈妈啊，你站在老家的山脊上往南看，再看我一眼吧，再看我最后一眼！
我的妈妈，您看到了吗？那英勇拼杀的就是我，共和国的旗帜上有我的血！】
“你们都他娘的给我活着回来！”高团长鼻子一酸，瞪大了眼睛，眼眶通红。
“是！”

"Instructor, in addition to saying something to my parents, I also want to say something to my uncle. I want to tell my uncle that he participated in the aid of Vietnam before, and the bitch bit back after eating. This time, I asked them to spit out everything they put into their stomachs."
.......
Captain Gao and Political Commissar Zhao rushed to inspect each company and brought some condolences.
"Is there any problem with your company?" Captain Gao looked at Liu Jimin and Ma Guisheng.
"Report to the leader, there is no problem." Ma Guisheng said.
"What about you!"
"No problem!"
"When I came here, Section Chief Wang asked you if you had finished the article that the military newspaper invited you to write?"
"I wrote two articles."
"I'll take it back in a while. It's not easy for you to take things out in this place. You should train hard and don't neglect your ideological work. I see that your Ninth Company's fighting spirit is very high and your fear of difficulties is gone. This is good, but we must do better. The consultants and anti-aircraft artillery units who participated in the war in Vietnam have sent a lot of information. You should study it quickly."
"Yes!"
Before leaving, Captain Gao came to Liu Jimin's room. Liu Jimin took out a dozen pieces of manuscript paper from the table and handed them to Captain Gao.
Liu Jimin wrote a total of two articles for the military newspaper. The first article was called "Voices of Young Soldiers: Please Rest assured to the Motherland and the People."
This article uses in-depth interviews with soldiers to show the true thoughts of the grassroots companies, as well as the soldiers' hatred of the enemy's cruelty to their compatriots on the border and their determination to kill the enemy and serve the country.
The second article is called "The Cutest Person in the New Era" and tells the story of how the soldiers maintained an optimistic fighting spirit in the difficult environment during the last Spring Festival before going abroad and spent the last Spring Festival well.
Captain Gao was silent for a long time when he saw the last paragraph of "The Cutest Person in the New Era".
[Motherland, this is my last Spring Festival before I go on an expedition. Let me take another look at you!
Mom, this is my first time going abroad. Maybe I will collapse and never come back!
Mom, stand on the ridge of your hometown and look south. Take another look at me, take one last look at me!
My mother, have you seen it? It is I who fight bravely, and my blood is on the flag of the Republic! 】
"You all come back alive for the fuck!" Captain Gao's nose felt sore, his eyes widened and his eyes were red.
"Yes!"
